parent_objective: audit proposal-source preflight before any selected-proposal repair design
blocked_by: M1650 selected same-line repair candidates as metadata only and requires audit before repair design

public_gates: M1651 must audit the M1650 proposal-source preflight pass
M1651 must verify candidate coverage and selected repair candidates
M1651 must verify no projection repair PPO checkpoint artifact or promotion
M1651 must state supported and unsupported claims
M1651 must decide selected-proposal repair design pivot or stop
M1651 must keep promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat diagnostics as positive targets
do not treat donor_plus_hidden_action as a loss target

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits no-checkpoint proposal-source preflight before selected-proposal repair design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no PPO, training, projection, proposal repair, checkpoint artifact, closed-loop gate, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if audit treats proposal-source availability as repair evidence
stop if audit routes directly to checkpoint artifact or promotion
stop if audit ignores same-line-not-PPO claim boundary
stop if guardrails or selected candidate counts fail
fallback_plan: admit selected-proposal no-checkpoint repair design if preflight is clean
pivot to proposal-source construction if no selected candidates are acceptable
stop branch if preflight artifacts are not sufficient for repair design

admission_evidence: M1650 official run wrote summary candidate and guardrail artifacts
M1650 passed no-checkpoint source preflight gates
allowed_updates: M1651 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if audit admits selected-proposal repair design, pivot, or stop
next_stage_criteria: same-line proposal claim boundary is explicit
promotion and private holdout remain blocked unless a later design admits them

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1651 audits fixed proposal-source metrics and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audits exact correct/wrong hidden residual metrics only; no new closed-loop history intervention
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1362, M1630, and M1650 public artifacts only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the preflight is insufficient, route to source construction or pivot before selected-proposal repair.
allowed_claims: proposal-source preflight audit and route decision
no training, no PPO, no projection, no checkpoint artifact, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1650 source preflight is sufficient to admit selected-proposal no-checkpoint repair design without overstating it as repair or closed-loop evidence.
success_criteria: audit records candidate coverage and selected repair candidate counts
audit verifies no projection repair PPO checkpoint artifact or promotion
audit states supported and unsupported claims
PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit treats preflight as proposal repair evidence
audit routes directly to checkpoint artifact PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes or closed-loop evidence
audit claims paper-level or level3 self-identification evidence
decision_rule: M1651 passes if it audits M1650 and chooses a safe next route before selected-proposal repair or checkpoint artifact generation.
